definition: a decision that does not hold yet

directives.name: Resolve When Found
directives.act: Move or delete an intent entry as soon as you find it true, not when the work on it closes.
directives.warrant: Nothing re-reads an entry, so one that came true and stayed sends someone at a gap already shut.
aids: Check the whole claim, not just the case you met.
Resolve the entry you found, not the section.
